claims.text: MSM and TGW w a bact STI (syphilis, chlamydia or gonorrhea) in past 12 mo: counsel on doxy-PEP
claims.quote: CDC recommends that MSM and TGW who have had a bacterial STI (specifically syphilis, chlamydia, or gonorrhea) diagnosed in the past 12 months should receive counseling that doxy PEP can be used as postexposure prophylaxis to prevent these infections.
claims.locator: Bachmann LH, et al. CDC Clinical Guidelines on the Use of Doxycycline Postexposure Prophylaxis for Bacterial Sexually Transmitted Infection Prevention, United States, 2024. MMWR Recomm Rep. 2024;73(2):1-8 (PMC11166373)

claims.text: Doxycycline 200 mg once w.in 72 hrs of oral, vaginal or anal sex; ⍉>200 mg per 24 hrs
claims.quote: doxycycline (any formulation) 200 mg once within 72 hours (not to exceed 200 mg per 24 hours) of oral, vaginal, or anal sex
claims.locator: Bachmann LH, et al. CDC Clinical Guidelines on the Use of Doxycycline Postexposure Prophylaxis for Bacterial Sexually Transmitted Infection Prevention, United States, 2024. MMWR Recomm Rep. 2024;73(2):1-8 (PMC11166373)

claims.text: ↓syphilis and chlamydia by >70%, gonorrhea by ≈50% (three RCTs)
claims.quote: In three large randomized controlled trials, 200 mg of doxycycline taken within 72 hours after sex has been shown to reduce syphilis and chlamydia infections by >70% and gonococcal infections by approximately 50%.
claims.locator: Bachmann LH, et al. CDC Clinical Guidelines on the Use of Doxycycline Postexposure Prophylaxis for Bacterial Sexually Transmitted Infection Prevention, United States, 2024. MMWR Recomm Rep. 2024;73(2):1-8 (PMC11166373)

claims.quote: No recommendation can be given at this time on the use of doxy PEP for cisgender women, cisgender heterosexual men, transgender men, and other queer and nonbinary persons.
claims.locator: Bachmann LH, et al. CDC Clinical Guidelines on the Use of Doxycycline Postexposure Prophylaxis for Bacterial Sexually Transmitted Infection Prevention, United States, 2024. MMWR Recomm Rep. 2024;73(2):1-8 (PMC11166373)
